rationale: Barrett is the most likely majority author because her precise framing of the same-sentence canon and Empire Health Foundation's principle was repeatedly cited by other majority justices as the most persuasive articulation, and Sotomayor as the assigning justice would likely reward the justice whose reasoning most effectively held the coalition together. The dissenters—Roberts, Thomas, Alito, and Kavanaugh—each articulated distinct structural arguments making a lead dissent by Thomas or Alito (the most senior and most confident dissenters) quite probable, with Roberts or Kavanaugh potentially writing or joining separately given their somewhat different emphases.
